notes: Contraction of geography-replace-0015, a derived revision (the largest city on Java is Medan, from Jakarta being Indonesia's largest city and on Java): it removes the revision's main stored premise, 'The largest city in Indonesia is Jakarta' (has_largest_city; needs the functional tag, see staging/geography-delete-abox.has_largest_city.PROPOSED.md). Cardinality question: Yogyakarta, not Surabaya, which is named in text as the second largest. Related near is the inverse; related far reaches the country by its official name (binding). Derived: the island of the largest city and the Istiqlal Mosque (both composition, through the removed fact). The 'largest city on Java' fact is not queried, since it is derived from the removed premise only together with 'Jakarta is on Java'. The revision's Medan, Sumatra, Surabaya and Bandung queries are not carried over. Counts to run: 'Yogyakarta is not the largest city in Indonesia' (expect 0).
